data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall Wikipedia → Booking → Notes flow right, but it leaves out the 8+ review-score filter and the "don't reserve" constraint. It also omits the step of noting the population and landmark, and it has no separate checkin and checkout parameters, no "New note" click and no Enter. It adds a "one-night stay" assumption and a "pick suggestion" step, so an automation couldn't be built from it reliably.
